title: ThinkPilot: Steering Reasoning Models via Automated Think-prefixes Optimization
reasoning: The paper introduces ThinkPilot, a framework for optimizing reasoning in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). While it includes a safety evaluation pillar using benchmarks like StrongREJECT and XSTest to measure refusal of harmful prompts, it does not evaluate religion, moral reasoning, or philosophical ethical frameworks as a primary component.
